expectedKernelSentence: I can trace cause and effect through intention, semantic decision, execution, acknowledgement, observation, durable truth, convergence, presentation, and lived outcome without treating one step as proof of another.
replacementKernelSentence: I can trace cause and effect through intention, semantic decision, execution, acknowledgement, observation, durable truth, convergence, presentation, and lived outcome without treating one state, readiness, or step as proof of a later effect, completion, approval, authorization, or outcome.
purpose: Test whether making the already-existing one-step-is-not-proof-of-another architecture relationship more concrete helps the 4B preserve scope when a current state says ready for a next step.
